note.title: Model answers and sentence building
note.overview: This lesson contains 50 enabled questions. It teaches Model answers and sentence building through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for Model answers and sentence building.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Use the five-step recipe: time phrase, tense, detail, opinion/reason, link.
Keep one time frame controlled before mixing tenses.
Present models describe habits; passé composé models report completed actions; futur proche models give plans.
Proofread articles, auxiliaries, agreement and negatives.

workedExamples.prompt: “Normalement, le matin, je vais au collège et je retrouve mes amis.”
workedExamples.answer: Usually, in the morning, I go to school and meet my friends.
workedExamples.why: The model sentence uses present: “Normalement, le matin, je vais au collège et je retrouve mes amis.”

workedExamples.prompt: “Je pense que c’est intéressant parce que c’est éducatif.”
workedExamples.answer: I think it is interesting because it is educational.
workedExamples.why: The model sentence uses present: “Je pense que c’est intéressant parce que c’est éducatif.”

Do not translate isolated words while losing the sentence time frame.
